prompt: A large fine-art painting for the wall of a luxury Nordic lodge: a misty Norwegian boreal valley at dawn, layers of spruce-covered ridges fading into soft fog, a calm river winding through, painted in loose expressive oil with visible brushwork, a palette of deep forest greens, sage, moss and warm pale mist with a touch of soft gold light. Calm, minimal, Scandinavian, gallery quality. No frame, no text, the painting fills the whole image edge to edge.
